title: Retail twin (home and trade) data contract v1
description: Five tables a hardware store can export from its POS, inventory, web-order, rostering and door-counter systems. No customer names, emails, phone numbers, addresses or card numbers are needed, no account holder names and no staff names; the importer ignores columns that look like personal information and hashes trade account ids before keeping them. Money is NZD excl. GST. Independent assembl concept.

source_system.description: POS or ERP name and version

txn.description: Transaction, docket or receipt number. Several rows share one txn. Also recognised as: transaction, transaction_id, receipt, receipt_no, docket, docket_no, invoice, invoice_no, sale_id, txn_id.

ts.description: When the line was sold (POS) or the counting interval started (door counter). Also recognised as: timestamp, date_time, datetime, sale_time, time, date, created, sold_at.

store.description: Store or branch code, for multi-store exports. Also recognised as: store_id, branch, site, location, outlet, store_no.

lane.description: Till, register or terminal. Self-checkouts are recognised from the text (self, SCO, kiosk). Also recognised as: till, register, terminal, pos, checkout, lane_id, till_no.

customer_type.description: Trade or DIY as the POS records it. If absent, a line with an account id counts as trade. Also recognised as: segment, customer_segment, channel, trade_diy, cust_type, type.

account_id.description: Trade account number. Hashed on load with a per-session salt; the raw number is never kept. Account holder names are ignored. Also recognised as: account, trade_account, account_no, account_number, customer_id, customer_no, acct.

sku.description: Item code, article or barcode. Also recognised as: item, item_code, product, product_code, article, barcode, plu, item_no.

department.description: Department or category, used to group lines into the twin's six classes. Also recognised as: dept, category, class, product_group, group, section.

qty.description: Units sold (negative for a refund). Also recognised as: quantity, units, qty_sold, units_sold.

net.description: Net sales for the line, excl. GST. Also recognised as: net_sales, net_amount, amount, sales, value, line_total, total_excl_gst, sales_excl_gst, revenue.

cost.description: Cost of the line, if the POS carries it. Otherwise margin uses the twin's 33% estimate. Also recognised as: cogs, cost_amount, line_cost, cost_price, unit_cost.

promo.description: Promotion code or flag, if the line sold on promotion. Also recognised as: promotion, promo_code, on_promo, deal, promo_flag.

sku.description: Item code, article or barcode. Also recognised as: item, item_code, product, product_code, article, barcode, item_no.

store.description: Store or branch code, for multi-store exports. Also recognised as: store_id, branch, site, location, outlet.

snapshot_at.description: When the stock count was taken. Also recognised as: date, as_at, as_of, snapshot, snapshot_date, count_date.

department.description: Department or category, used to group lines into the twin's six classes. Also recognised as: dept, category, class, product_group, group.

on_hand.description: Units on hand. Also recognised as: soh, stock_on_hand, qty_on_hand, onhand, stock, available.

on_order.description: Units on order with suppliers. Also recognised as: soo, stock_on_order, qty_on_order, onorder, ordered.

reorder_point.description: Reorder point or minimum stock. Also recognised as: rop, min, min_stock, reorder_level, reorder.

lead_time.description: Supplier lead time in days. Also recognised as: lead_time_days, leadtime, lt, supplier_lead_time.

unit_cost.description: Average cost per unit, to value the stock. Also recognised as: cost, avg_cost, average_cost, cost_price.

order_id.description: Web order number. Also recognised as: order, order_no, order_number, web_order, reference, ref.

placed.description: When the customer placed the order. Also recognised as: placed_at, ordered, order_date, created, created_at, order_time.

promised.description: When the store promised it would be ready. If absent, two hours after placing is assumed and labelled Estimate. Also recognised as: promised_at, ready_by, due, sla, promise.

picked.description: When picking finished. Also recognised as: picked_at, ready, ready_at, pick_complete, completed.

collected.description: When the customer took it. Also recognised as: collected_at, picked_up, handed_over, fulfilled.

status.description: Collected, cancelled, waiting and so on. Also recognised as: order_status, state.

value.description: Order value, excl. GST. Also recognised as: total, order_value, amount, net.

start.description: Shift start. Also recognised as: shift_start, start_time, from, clock_in, begin.

end.description: Shift end. Also recognised as: shift_end, end_time, to, clock_out, finish.

role.description: Area or role: trade desk, yard, checkouts, floor, pickers, garden, receiving. Also recognised as: position, area, department, job, team.

staff_ref.description: A payroll or employee number, not a name. Used only to count people. Also recognised as: employee_id, staff_id, emp_id, payroll_id.

paid_hours.description: Paid hours for the shift, if the roster states them. Also recognised as: hours, paid, duration_hours.

ts.description: When the line was sold (POS) or the counting interval started (door counter). Also recognised as: timestamp, date_time, datetime, period, interval_start, hour, time, date.

count.description: People counted entering in the interval. Also recognised as: visitors, entries, in, count_in, footfall, traffic.

door.description: Which entrance or sensor. Also recognised as: entrance, sensor, zone, door_id.
